population: All cached fit and dev natural gold-labelled path-node occurrences; feed only condition and unmodified patient to verifier. Gold and R0 joined after both decisions. No source/case/GID as prediction feature.
development_usage: Retrospective mechanism evaluation on previously used sources. Fit error audit identified two measurements in two guidelines. No independent-test claim.
allowed_rules: Is preoperative Hb <13.0 g/dL (in either men or women)?
收缩压是否在90~120 mmHg范围内？
method: require exact question, bound measurement object and same-unit numeric observation; Hb requires preoperative time in the same sentence; references to pulmonary artery pressure excluded; ambiguous, missing or inconsistent comparison falls back to R0.
baseline: first number in the patient with the prescribed unit, followed by the same exact threshold or interval; missing/out-of-scope falls back to R0.
evaluation_scope: Fit/dev gold-labelled natural nodes only; no test source. Group by stage, source and rule, including out-of-scope in the overall denominator.
